risks: Buy-to-let mortgages are less risky, at the same LTV, than traditional mortgages. Borrowers will rarely default on
either type of mortgage if the asset is worth more than the loan. However, for buy-to-let, you have an additional
protection in that borrowers will also not default if the mortgage service cost is less than the rent they receive –
there is no point in throwing the keys back at the bank if you are making money from the a sset. For a lender like
OSB, what we like to see is a low LTV and a high rent : interest ratio.
